overall_goal: Add butter to the edges of the pancake, loosen it, and flip it multiple times to cook evenly

goals.description: Apply butter to the edges of the pancake
goals.rationale: The person picks up butter and spreads it around the boundaries of the pancake using a spatula.

goals.description: Loosen the pancake and flip it over
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to scratch the edges of the pancake, presses the vegetables into it, and then flips it to cook the other side.

goals.description: Apply more butter and loosen the pancake to prevent sticking
goals.rationale: The person adds more butter to the edges with a knife and uses the spatula to scratch the boundaries and lower surface so the pancake does not stick.

goals.description: Press and flip the pancake again for even cooking
goals.rationale: The person presses the pancake to cook it evenly, flips it over again using spatulas, and adjusts the pan on the flame.

goals.description: Reattach a broken piece of the pancake and finish cooking
goals.rationale: The person picks up a broken piece of the pancake, places it back into the pan, and presses the surface to ensure it is fully cooked.
